files.description: ZIP archive containing the complete EHI export documentation package: companion guide (DOCX), data dictionary crosswalk (XLSX), and SQL queries. This is the primary artifact.

files.path: downloads/(1) myEvolv All EHI Export Companion Guide.docx
files.description: Companion guide explaining EHI export configuration, usage, obtaining export files, JSON format interpretation with worked examples, type code legend, and glossary of terms. Last updated 11/04/2024.

files.path: downloads/(2) myEvolv All EHI Export Data Dictionary Crosswalk.xlsx
files.description: Massive data dictionary crosswalk with 5 sheets: Events (1,679 event definitions across 119 categories), Events + Columns (115,663 field-level entries), Non-Events (250 form definitions), Non-Events + Columns (21,006 field-level entries). Covers 87 unique database tables.

files.path: downloads/(3) myEvolv ALL EHI Export Queries.sql
files.description: Four T-SQL SELECT queries that agencies can run against their myEvolv database to generate their own data dictionary crosswalk including user-defined events and forms.
Certification status letter and mandatory disclosures for myEvolv Certified Edition 11.0, dated April 4, 2025. Lists certified criteria, CQMs, and cost/fee information.
Full-page screenshot of the myEvolv EHI All Data Export page showing the export description, download link, and content variability notes.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the XLSX data dictionary crosswalk and extracts all sheets into queryable JSON files.
Extracted JSON: 1,679 event definitions with category_name, category_code, event_name, event_definition_id, table_name, form_name, form_code.
Extracted JSON: 115,663 field-level records for all events including form fields, subform fields, and assessment questions with type codes.
Extracted JSON: 250 non-event form definitions with form_name, form_code, form_family_name, form_family_id.
Extracted JSON: 21,006 field-level records for non-event forms including form fields, subform fields, and assessment questions.
Coverage/accounting output: sheet counts, record counts, lists of all 119 event categories, 87 table names, 17 form families, and type codes found.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, known limitations.
